product_metadata.title: Cardboard Santa Sleigh Stand up for Christmas (5 feet Long) Party Decor
features: Make this sleigh the center of your Christmas display! A great addition to your holiday decorations and an easy way to set up for a party, this stand-up cutout makes a great photo opportunity, too.
Decorated with a festive red and green Christmas design and the initials "SC", this sleigh decoration is perfect for Santa's visit at the holiday party.
Simple assembly required. Stand-ups are one-sided with a brown cardboard back.
